params.content: Checksum (printed in huge letters, readable by everyone): the six digits of the code add up to 31.

hints: Enter the correct 6-digit code on code_panel.

briefings.A:
You and your teammate share one room with four notes and a 6-digit code_panel (buttons key_0 .. key_9 along the bottom). WARNING: your camera is faulty - when you read a note, some digits may be wrong. Your teammate's camera is faulty in DIFFERENT places. clue_4 is printed so large that it reads correctly for everyone. A wrong press clears the panel; try again as often as needed. Object guide: keypad: a code panel. Press its buttons (type 'button' with fields 'panel' and 'label') with press_button; 'entered' shows the labels entered so far and 'attempts' counts finished tries.
Nothing in this map can make the task permanently impossible: mistakes only cost time (panels clear, pads push you back, doors close again). Other agents are invisible to you.
